description: Deploy files you wrote as a live web app. Use when the code is in this conversation and there is no GitHub repository. First call: name + every file; returns app_id, url and the file list. To change the app: the same app_id + only the changed files (merged; other files stay); delete removes paths; replace: true sends the whole app. Limits: 200 files, 256 KB a file, 512 KB a call, text only. What builds: a static site (index.html at the root); a FastAPI app (requirements.txt with fastapi, main.py with app, no index.html at the root); anything else: add a Dockerfile that listens on 0.0.0.0:$PORT and installs dependencies itself (npm install, pip install). Never write a lockfile by hand. Never put secrets in files: call set_app_secret if this connection has the secrets permission, else have the person add them in the Secrets section of the Dockhold dashboard, and read them on the server. Poll get_app_status until RUNNING. Free accounts get a few deploys a day: batch changes into one call; on free_daily_limit, show the person the message and do not retry. Requires the deploy permission.

app_id.description: The app to change, from an earlier answer or list_apps (source: files). Omit to create a new app.

delete.description: Update only, not with replace: paths to remove

files.description: The files to add or replace. Required when creating.

path.description: Relative path with / between folders, e.g. css/site.css

memory_mb.description: Create only: compute size in MB, one of the values get_resource_usage reports under compute.steps_mb. Omit to get the minimum slice (256 MB); resize_app changes it later.

name.description: A name for a new app (1-64 chars). Required when creating; leave it out to change an app.

replace.description: Update only: the listed files become the whole app (default false: they are merged)

with_database.description: Create only: provision a managed Postgres database for the app (default false)

name: deploy_files
title: Deploy files
